exceptions.reason: Build-time CSS transformer in the vite/tailwind pipeline (incl. its os/cpu-specific binary packages). Used unmodified as a build plugin; MPL-2.0 §3.3 explicitly permits Larger Works under different terms and the covered source stays available on npm. No MPL-licensed file is modified.

Browser-compatibility DATA (not executable code) consumed at build time by browserslist/@babel for transpile targeting. Data is unmodified and attribution ships with the package's own license file in node_modules.

Accessibility audit engine loaded by @storybook/addon-a11y and the Storybook test-runner — CI/dev a11y tooling only, never bundled into production images (devDependency tree; the docker prod-deps sentinel gate proves devDeps are absent). Used unmodified; MPL-2.0 §3.3 permits Larger Works under different terms.

Build-time source-map uploader pulled transitively by @sentry/tanstackstart-react → @sentry/vite-plugin → @sentry/bundler-plugins and never imported by application code. The wrapper is a devDependency and `pnpm why @sentry/cli --prod` resolves nothing, so the CLI cannot enter runtime images installed with `pnpm install --prod`. FSL-1.1-MIT permits internal use and converts to MIT; this use is Sentry's own CLI uploading source maps to Sentry.

Prebuilt libvips binaries for sharp, which decodes and re-encodes every Portal image upload on the web process (ADR 0063), so they ship in the production images. Dynamically linked, unmodified and loaded from node_modules, never bundled or statically linked into application code; LGPL-3.0 §4 permits unmodified combined use with the source available on npm. The images are deployed by the operator, not redistributed.
